raw_response:
This land is big — nearly eight hectares — and I have farmed here many years without ever buying fertilizer from the shop. We keep cattle like most Sukuma families here in Shinyanga, so I will spread manure from the kraal on the parts that are tired. I plant my own seeds that I keep from last season, and I intercrop so if one crop fails another will feed us. With this much land I cannot do it alone at my age, so I will call neighbors and pay some young men to help with clearing and weeding.
